violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Thawed, pre-cooked chicken wings portioned in a zip lock bag were not labeled and date marked. -Hot dogs in a zip lock bag were not labeled and date marked. -Lettuce in a zip lock bag were not labeled and date marked.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -The shelf ends in the kitchen are not sealed and have exposed wood. -Walk-in cooler door frame and door are bare wood and should be sealed.
